changes: Real Worker, Manager and Reviewer attempts share a finite project allowance. The immutable attempt history and original project snapshot supply the counter; no separate mutable balance or schema was introduced.

New requests and explicit attempts consume one unit even if their result is unknown, failed or stopped. Idempotent reuse and original-run status reads do not consume another unit. Mock history is excluded.
Worker and management dispatch expose existing waiting reasons with allowance details. The transaction preparing a new request rechecks and serializes admission; rollback leaves no published attempt.

The deployed limit defaults to 128 and accepts 1..4096. Changing this operator policy preserves existing counts. The unit is host_request, not actual Provider calls, tokens, runtime seconds, internal credits or dollars.

Nine additional boundary cases were added after implementation. The mock test initially attempted two first Worker requests with the same idempotency key; it was corrected to the existing explicit attempt chain without relaxing production identity rules.
